subject: Parallelism using R-INLA on Debian cluster

messages.author: 959bffbdb3ddae02
messages.subject: Parallelism using R-INLA on Debian cluster
parts:
Dear INLA community,

I am running a simulation study and I would like to run the simulation in parallel. For this I am using the packages "foreach" and "doParallel".

However, I am experimenting a strange problem:
When I run the simulation in parallel, my results are always wrong in the sense that I get fixed effects almost equal to zero. This happens if I just the command %dopar%.

When instead of using %dopar% I use %do% (running the simulation sequential and not in parallel), the results are then satisfactory.

I also tried this using the "future" package to parallelize my code but the results were also wrong.

The cluster has the R version 4.0.4 (2021-02-15) installed  and has the Linux version "Debian GNU/Linux 11 (bullseye)".

Is this a common problem? If yes, how can I fix this?

Thank you in advance.

Best regards

Rafael

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Parallelism using R-INLA on Debian cluster
parts:
the easy way out (and what I always do), is to avoid to parallelize with
R, but rather run several instances or R itself in shell, like this

#!/usr/bin/env bash

for i in $(seq 1 100); do
Rscript --vanilla do.R $i $RANDOM >> LOG-$i 2>&1 &
done
